title: Implement CCP-15 interference score and consume ccp-interference.json
description: Vector file test/vectors/ccp-interference.json (busy_pct+PER*100 score, backoff jitter math oracles) has no implementation in python/src/lichen or rust lichen-core rf_health.rs exposes only record_* state APIs. Implement the CCP-15 math (python oracle first) and wire a pytest consumer. Discovered during f4z7 orphan audit.
